jobs.title: Armed High-End Retail Security Specialist
jobs.description:
St. Moritz Security Services, Inc. is seeking a Commissioned High End Retail Security Officer for the River Oaks District (Houston Regional Office). The role focuses on observing, reporting, and patrolling to ensure a secure environment for clients and visitors.

Pay is $18.50 per hour with a schedule from Thursday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The position is full-time and requires a valid license/permit, plus strong customer service and reporting skills.

jobs.title: Security Driver Patrol: Retail Safety & Service Pro
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Driver Patrol Coverage in Houston, TX. In this full-time role, you will provide visitor and site security, drive patrols, and maintain a visible presence to deter incidents while delivering excellent customer service.

You’ll need a valid driver’s license, be at least 18 for unarmed roles, and pass background checks and drug screening. Join a team focused on reliability, agility, and integrity in a people-first culture.
